macros.name: pgfparserdef
macros.doc: This command should be used repeatedly to define a parser named ⟨parser name⟩.

macros.name: pgfparserdefunknown
macros.doc: With this macro you can define an ⟨action⟩ for the ⟨parser name⟩ parser in ⟨state⟩ if no action was defined for the letter which was encountered.

macros.name: pgfparserparse
macros.doc: This command is used to parse the ⟨text⟩ using the (previously defined) parser named ⟨parser name⟩.

macros.name: pgfparserswitch
macros.doc: This command can be called inside the action code of a parser to cause a state switch to ⟨state⟩.
